name: TassHunting
description: Hunting overhaul: sticky arrows and spears ride the animal they hit (grab a stuck spear back at melee range), true-aim spawn, tiered arrow break chances (steel never breaks, primitive arrows snap), stacking bleed damage with server-synced blood trails, pools and blood-in-water (late joiners see and can follow the same trail - no BloodTrail needed), animals flee AWAY from the hunter, predator overhaul (apex terror bears, tactical wolf packs), predator footsteps audible at realistic ranges, extended projectile pickup, harvest overhaul (faster knife work, loot drops on the ground instead of a window, empty corpses self-remove). Everything config-gated, with an in-game settings panel when ConfigLib is installed.
